column1: # Android 7.1.2 notification shade and quick settings (ng-shade.js): QuickStatusBarHeader, the tiles of quick_settings_tiles_default as
# their handleUpdateState picks them (white on qs_background_primary), the brightness slider's thumb in systemui_theme
# The simulator's first-boot welcome notification (as every version): SystemUI's ic_android robot, a mask the header tints
# QSDetail: QSDetailItems' access point levels (AccessPointControllerImpl.ICONS) and the lock over a secured one, the disconnect
# button, the empty states; ZenModePanel's introduction close and the countdown's minus / plus (theme: systemui_theme)
# framework Material RadioButton (btn_radio_material_anim: btn_radio_off_mtrl / btn_radio_on_mtrl), masks the CSS colours (ZenModePanel conditions)
# Nougat tiles of quick_settings_tiles_stock beyond the default ones (DataSaverTile, CastTile, HotspotTile unavailable) and the data saver status icon
# QSCustomizer toolbar (Theme.DeviceDefault.Settings.Dark): homeAsUpIndicator and the overflow, masks the CSS colours
